'''2014 Worlds Reset Beta Norman Lansing LS Careful Planning (V)''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Norman Lansing]] at [[2014 World Championship Reset Beta]].

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[Norman Lansing]]
* '''Event:''' [[2014 World Championship Reset Beta]]
* '''Stage:''' Results

* '''Side:''' [[Light]]

* '''Starting Interrupt:''' [[Careful Planning (V)]]
* '''Source:''' [https://www.starwarsccg.org/worlds-2014-reset-beta-event-norman-lansing-ls-ebo-attack-run/ PC list]
